instruction: Adversarial review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020F at completeness/governance lens. Slice claims to deliver, per WP-SCP-020 §4 020F: (i) preset exported via `github>jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-//renovate/default#<tag>`; (ii) regex-managers bump wrapper @SHA + comment-tag (not tag alone); (iii) preset versioned with own tag series `renovate/v1.0.0` independent of workflow tag series; (iv) CODEOWNERS on `renovate/**` requires named reviewer(s); (v) `.github/dependabot.yml` monitors `.github/workflows/*.yml` and `policies/**` (closure of m-sec-4); (vi) SCP self consumes its own preset in this WP (in-WP cascade validation); (vii) org-config verification (U-sec-3 + U-gov-1) closes before slice opens. VERIFY EACH SUB-CRITERION: (1) Sub-criterion (i): the preset path expression `github>jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-//renovate/default` is correct Renovate preset shorthand. The `#<tag>` suffix is what an adopter would append to pin to a specific preset version. Verify SCP-self's renovate.json uses this shorthand (it should — per the (vi) requirement). (2) Sub-criterion (ii): the customManager regex MUST bump @SHA + comment-tag together. The DISPATCH-NOTE claims this; verify by reading `renovate/default.json` customManagers[0].matchStrings — both `currentDigest` and `currentValue` capture groups should be present and named correctly per Renovate's regex-manager docs. (3) Sub-criterion (iii): tag series `renovate/v*` independent of workflow `v*` is asserted in DISPATCH-NOTE.md but NOT actually cut as part of this PR (it's a post-merge step). Is this acceptable for slice acceptance? The slice spec says 'preset versioned with own tag series'. Strict reading: tag must exist. Pragmatic reading: the slice ships the preset; tagging is the trivial post-merge step. Flag if you think the slice acceptance criterion isn't fully closed until the tag is cut. (4) Sub-criterion (iv): CODEOWNERS rule `renovate/** @jrnb2024` was added in slice 020K. Verify it's still present (CODEOWNERS file landed at line position not relative to a wildcard rule before it). (5) Sub-criterion (v): the spec says dependabot.yml monitors `.github/workflows/*.yml` AND `policies/**`. Renovate covers `policies/**` indirectly via the customManager + tool-versions. Dependabot doesn't natively support Rego/policy files — the dispatch-note correctly explains this. Verify the dependabot.yml header documents the Renovate/Dependabot split clearly so a future reader understands why `policies/**` is missing from dependabot.yml's `directory:` list. (6) Sub-criterion (vi): SCP-self's renovate.json must `extends: ["github>jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-//renovate/default"]`. Verify present and well-formed JSON. (7) Sub-criterion (vii): U-sec-3 + U-gov-1 closure. The plan's §6 says Renovate Bot is hosted by Mend and already active on jrnb2024. The org-config verification step is implicitly satisfied — the Renovate app is installed; SCP can use it. Verify the dispatch-note acknowledges this. (8) Cross-reference check: the canonical adopter wrapper marker pattern that the customManager regex matches is supposed to be documented at WP-SCP-020 020H part 3 (ADOPT-001 §12). 020H part 3 is NOT yet shipped — the marker is currently only present in SCP-self's wrapper. Flag if 020F is shipping a customManager that depends on a marker convention that isn't yet documented for adopters. (9) Cross-reference check: the DISPATCH-NOTE.md slice acceptance checklist boxes are checked but item (iii) tag-cut is documented as a post-merge step. Is the checklist accurate? (10) STATUS.md / plan §3 sequence: should this slice update either? (Plan §3 already shows 020F in the post-USER-GATE-A queue; STATUS.md was updated at Threshold A close.) Any drift, omission, or undocumented assumption is a finding. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3 fixpoint criteria. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
